approved: Customs Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Bill 2014

Supported the Product Stewardship for Oil bills, saying the scheme is running a $10 million deficit, and highlighted the new $55 million Southern Oil re-refining plant in Gladstone, which processes about 30 per cent of Australia's waste lube oil and employs 45 people.

Detailed the Northern Oil Refinery in Gladstone, which can process 100 million litres of oil a year, the same as Queensland's entire annual waste oil production, and said it injects an estimated $15 million into the regional economy each year while employing 40 people directly.

Defended the Product Stewardship for Oil bills, saying annual used oil collection has risen from about 160 million to 270 million litres since the scheme began, supporting an oil recycling industry with a combined turnover of at least $3 billion.
Customs Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Act 2014
